item.title: New Ocklawaha River restoration bill provides Marion County with economic benefits, voice in decision-making
item.description: New legislation introduced in the Florida Senate and House of Representatives could finally set a concrete timeline for the restoration of the Ocklawaha River, while offering Marion County significant influence over the process and a dedicated economic development program. Read more: New Ocklawaha River restoration bill provides Marion County with economic benefits, voice in decision-making

item.title: Robert Jackson Williams
item.description: Robert Williams was a devoted friend, a brother in Christ, and a pillar of his community. Jack was proud to be known as a loving husband, father, grandfather, and friend. Read more: Robert Jackson Williams

item.title: Suspect killed Ocala resident in front yard in ‘random act of violence,’ police say
item.description: A 29-year-old man has been arrested and charged with homicide following a shooting on Wednesday afternoon near the Ocala Historic District that police say was a "random act of violence." item.title: Carmen Del Valle

item.title: Elderly man says Home Depot’s delayed HVAC job impacted wife’s health, ruined holiday plans
item.description: A Dunnellon homeowner is suing Home Depot for more than $130,000, alleging that a stalled HVAC installation left his home without heat, ruined his family's holiday plans, and forced his sick wife to flee the property. Read more: Elderly man says Home Depot’s delayed HVAC job impacted wife’s health, ruined holiday plans

item.title: 19-year-old Ocala suspect in deadly Christmas shooting denied bond
item.description: A 19-year-old Ocala man, who was arrested last week in connection with a Christmas Day shooting that claimed the life of a 21-year-old father, has been denied bond and will remain incarcerated. Read more: 19-year-old Ocala suspect in deadly Christmas shooting denied bond

item.title: I would like to know where all of our extra property taxes are going in Marion County
item.description: "Where has all the money gone that has been collected from high property taxes? Not in widening roads or adding turn lanes, no changes to improve our safety on the road. It is poor planning and reflects poor judgements. For us paying our respective taxes, it would be greatly appreciated that a response from those individuals making these decisions were ever heard from.
